transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: You again. What do you want?

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I told you I would come back. I am Salim, the boy with the lost brother.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Salim... yes, that name sits somewhere near. You were here before, by the stone, or was it closer to the water.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: By the water. You kept asking me about the valley and I kept answering. Do you remember any of that?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: The valley... yes. I asked about the Sidr tree. You said it was still standing.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: That's right. And I told you about the rain and the bread and the goats. You remember.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: I remember asking. I remember keeping you here. I knew what I was doing, Salim.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I know you did. I am not angry. But I still need the prayer, and I am still asking.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: You are not angry. I kept you from your brother and you came back without anger. That is strange.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I made a promise. I don't break promises, even to people who don't deserve them.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: I did not deserve one. And yet here you stand. The answer is still no, Salim.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then I will sit here until it changes. I have nowhere else to be.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: You will sit. You are not arguing or shouting. You are just... sitting.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Yes. Because you are alone down here and that matters, even now.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Do not do that. Do not make me matter. That is a crueler thing than shouting.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I told you I would come back. I came back. That is all I have.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Forty years. Not one person came back. Not one shadow leaned down for me.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I know. And I am sorry for that. But I am here now.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: You came back... and you owed me nothing. You owed me nothing and you still came.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I told you I would. That's enough of a reason.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Something old in me is breaking open. I do not know how to stop it.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then don't. I am right here.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: I slowed you on purpose. I kept you talking so you would stay. And you came back anyway.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Yes. And I will come back again after this, if you need me to.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Do not promise that. One miracle is enough for a man who stopped counting them.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then just give me the prayer. Let me go save my brother. And know that I will remember you when I see sunlight again.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Take what I have guarded too long. Courage in my chest. Fire in my will. I do not break.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I have it. I won't let it go.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: There is one more. I never gave it to anyone who came back before — because no one ever did. Prayer for the lost: Light find my hand. Light find my path. Let the Sword of Light answer, and let it fade when the shadows loosen. Never say it twice in the same dark.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I will carry those words all the way to him. Thank you, Hanash. Not just for the prayer.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: If you make it out... remember I was here. That is all I ask.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I will remember. I swear it.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Go then. The silence you leave me will be a kinder one than the last forty years.
